limitations: This is a finite audit of two settings and six authored rivals, not a proof of universal rule uniqueness.
The stress sweep checks deterministic admitted scenes and Python claim construction; protected Racket replay is bounded to the recorded jobs and rivals.
Reviewer readiness does not grant owner acceptance or training admission.

causal_case.counterfactual_program:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((hh (rows g))
                  (ww (cols g))
                  (visited (make-hash))
                  (frames (list))
                  (dummy-f (for* ((r (range 0 hh)) (c (range 0 ww)))
                                 (when
                                   (and
                                     (!= (at g r c) 0)
                                     (not (hash-has-key? visited (list r c))))
                                   (let ((color (at g r c))
                                         (comp (list))
                                         (stack (list (list r c))))
                                     (let bfs
                                          ((stk stack))
                                          (unless
                                            (null? stk)
                                            (let* ((cur (car stk))
                                                   (rest (cdr stk))
                                                   (cr (first cur))
                                                   (cc (second cur)))
                                              (if (or
                                                    (< cr 0)
                                                    (>= cr hh)
                                                    (< cc 0)
                                                    (>= cc ww)
                                                    (!= (at g cr cc) color)
                                                    (hash-has-key? visited (list cr cc)))
                                                  (bfs rest)
                                                  (begin
                                                    (hash-set! visited (list cr cc) #t)
                                                    (set! comp (cons (list cr cc) comp))
                                                    (bfs (append (list (list (- cr 1)
                                                                             cc)
                                                                       (list (+ cr 1)
                                                                             cc)
                                                                       (list cr
                                                                             (- cc 1))
                                                                       (list cr
                                                                             (+ cc 1)))
                                                                 rest)))))))
                                     (let* ((rs (map first comp))
                                            (cs2 (map second comp))
                                            (rmin (min-list rs))
                                            (rmax (max-list rs))
                                            (cmin (min-list cs2))
                                            (cmax (max-list cs2))
                                            (ih (- rmax rmin 1))
                                            (iw (- cmax cmin 1))
                                            (has-pat (for/or ((dr (range 1
                                                                         (- rmax rmin))))
                                                             (for/or ((dc (range 1
                                                                                 (- cmax
                                                                                    cmin))))
                                                                     (= (at g
                                                                            (+ rmin dr)
                                                                            (+ cmin dc))
                                                                        color)))))
                                       (set! frames
                                             (cons (list color
                                                         rmin
                                                         cmin
                                                         rmax
                                                         cmax
                                                         ih
                                                         iw
                                                         has-pat)
                                                   frames)))))))
                  (template (car (filter (lambda (f) (list-ref f 7)) frames)))
                  (t-color (first template))
                  (t-rmin (second template))
                  (t-cmin (third template))
                  (t-ih (list-ref template 5))
                  (t-iw (list-ref template 6))
                  (pattern (list))
                  (dummy-pattern
                    (for* ((dr (range 0 t-ih)) (dc (range 0 t-iw)))
                      (when
                        (= (at g (+ t-rmin 1 dr) (+ t-cmin 1 dc)) t-color)
                        (set! pattern (cons (list dr dc) pattern)))))
                  (p-rows (map first pattern))
                  (p-cols (map second pattern))
                  (p-rmin (min-list p-rows))
                  (p-rmax (max-list p-rows))
                  (p-cmin (min-list p-cols))
                  (p-cmax (max-list p-cols))
                  (crop-h (+ 1 (- p-rmax p-rmin)))
                  (crop-w (+ 1 (- p-cmax p-cmin)))
                  (target-h t-ih)
                  (target-w t-iw)
                  (result (make-hash))
                  (dummy-draw
                    (for ((frame frames))
                      (let ((fc (first frame))
                            (rmin (second frame))
                            (cmin (third frame))
                            (rmax (list-ref frame 3))
                            (cmax (list-ref frame 4))
                            (ih (list-ref frame 5))
                            (iw (list-ref frame 6)))
                        (when
                          (and (= ih target-h) (= iw target-w))
                          (for* ((r (range rmin (+ rmax 1)))
                                 (c (range cmin (+ cmax 1))))
                            (when
                              (or (= r rmin) (= r rmax) (= c cmin) (= c cmax))
                              (hash-set! result (list r c) fc)))
                          (for ((cell pattern))
                            (let ((target-dr (- (first cell) p-rmin))
                                  (target-dc (- (second cell) p-cmin)))
                              (hash-set! result
                                         (list (+ rmin 1 target-dr)
                                               (+ cmin 1 target-dc))
                                         fc))))))))
             (build-grid hh ww (r c) (hash-ref result (list r c) 0))))))

sequential_dependency.intermediate: pattern bounding-box coordinates, crop dimensions, normalized pattern cells, and the frame(s) selected by those dimensions
sequential_dependency.step_a: locate the sole patterned template and derive the pattern's minimal bounding box plus normalized crop
sequential_dependency.step_b: select the unique empty frame whose interior equals the derived crop dimensions and stamp the normalized crop in that frame's color
sequential_dependency.why_b_depends_on_a: the target dimensions and therefore the target frame are unavailable until Step A derives the input-dependent pattern bounding box
